developments: The High Warden calls an emergency council of the twelve Bearer families about the dead deacon, the missing Heartstone, and the eye in the Skull. Someone will be named responsible.
Brother Pellam Smudge has painted the night of the sealing from rumor: a heroic oil of a tall golden boy with a sword, very little resemblance to Pip, already hanging in the Chapel nave.
The Marrow Guild calls its strike after all, refusing to dig another ounce of marrow for the Chapel until every Quiet Room is opened and accounted for.
